description: This file defines functions and types related to command execution allowlist management, including parsing, analyzing, and validating shell commands and executable paths for security purposes within a larger project.

methods.name: hasShellLineContinuation
methods.description: Checks if a command string contains a shell line continuation character.

methods.name: normalizeSafeBins
methods.description: Normalizes an array of safe bin entries into a set of lowercase, trimmed strings.

methods.name: resolveSafeBins
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes safe bin entries, defaulting to a predefined list if undefined.

methods.name: isSafeBinUsage
methods.description: Determines if a command argv is using a safe bin based on allowlist, resolution, and platform.

methods.name: isPathScopedExecutableToken
methods.description: Checks if a token includes path separators, indicating a scoped executable.

methods.name: pickExecAllowlistContext
methods.description: Creates a context object for allowlist evaluation, copying relevant properties.

methods.name: normalizeSkillBinName
methods.description: Trims and lowercases a skill bin name, returning null if empty.

methods.name: normalizeSkillBinResolvedPath
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes a skill bin path, converting backslashes to slashes on Windows.

methods.name: buildSkillBinTrustIndex
methods.description: Builds a map indexing trusted paths by skill bin name.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowedSegment
methods.description: Checks if a segment is an auto-allowed skill based on trust index and configuration.

methods.name: resolveSkillPreludePath
methods.description: Resolves a skill prelude file path, expanding home directory and resolving relative paths.

methods.name: isSkillMarkdownPreludePath
methods.description: Checks if a file path points to a skill markdown prelude.

methods.name: resolveSkillMarkdownPreludeId
methods.description: Extracts the skill ID from a skill markdown prelude file path.

methods.name: isSkillPreludeReadSegment
methods.description: Checks if a segment is a skill prelude read command for a specific file.

methods.name: isSkillPreludeMarkerSegment
methods.description: Checks if a segment is a skill prelude marker command.

methods.name: isSkillPreludeSegment
methods.description: Checks if a segment is a skill prelude segment (read or marker).

methods.name: isSkillPreludeOnlyEvaluation
methods.description: Checks if all segments are skill prelude segments.

methods.name: resolveSkillPreludeIds
methods.description: Resolves skill IDs from segments that are skill preludes.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistedSkillWrapperId
methods.description: Extracts skill ID from a wrapper executable name.

methods.name: resolveTrustedSkillExecutionIds
methods.description: Collects trusted skill IDs from analysis and evaluation.

methods.name: resolveShellWrapperScriptArgv
methods.description: Resolves the argument vector for a shell wrapper script.

methods.name: resolveSegmentAllowlistMatch
methods.description: Analyzes a command segment against the allowlist and inline commands.

methods.name: resolveSegmentSatisfaction
methods.description: Determines how a segment is satisfied (allowlist, safe bin, skill).

methods.name: resolveInlineChainFallback
methods.description: Attempts to evaluate inline command chains for allowlist satisfaction.

methods.name: evaluateShellWrapperInlineChain
methods.description: Recursively evaluates inline shell command chains for allowlist compliance.

methods.name: evaluateSegments
methods.description: Evaluates multiple command segments for allowlist satisfaction.

methods.name: resolveAnalysisSegmentGroups
methods.description: Returns segment groups from analysis, either chains or single segments.

methods.name: evaluateExecAllowlist
methods.description: Main function to evaluate if a command analysis satisfies the allowlist.

methods.name: hasSegmentExecutableMatch
methods.description: Checks if any candidate executable in a segment matches a predicate.

methods.name: isShellWrapperSegment
methods.description: Checks if a segment is a shell wrapper executable.

methods.name: hasDisqualifyingShellWrapperScriptOption
methods.description: Checks if a token disqualifies a script as a shell wrapper script.

methods.name: resolveShellWrapperScriptCandidatePath
methods.description: Resolves the script path from a shell wrapper segment.

methods.name: resolveShellWrapperPositionalArgvCandidatePath
methods.description: Resolves the path of a shell script invoked via positional arguments.

methods.name: isDirectShellPositionalCarrierInvocation
methods.description: Checks if a command string is a direct invocation of a shell positional carrier.

methods.name: escapeRegExpLiteral
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: buildScriptArgPatternFromArgv
methods.description: Builds a regex pattern for script arguments on Windows.

methods.name: buildArgPatternFromArgv
methods.description: Builds a regex pattern for command arguments on Windows.

methods.name: addAllowAlwaysPattern
methods.description: Adds a pattern to the list if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: collectAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively collects patterns for 'allow always' decisions from command segments.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatternEntries
methods.description: Returns a list of patterns for commands that should always be allowed.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Returns string patterns for 'allow always' command patterns.

methods.name: evaluateShellAllowlist
methods.description: Analyzes a shell command string against the allowlist, including chain operators.
